visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a blue patterned short-sleeved shirt, blue shorts, and a baseball cap swings a yellow plastic bat on a large green lawn. A small child in a purple outfit stands nearby, and a white Labrador dog is positioned ready to run. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds, and buildings are visible in the background. (2) The scene shifts as the white dog runs quickly across the grass, passing under the support lines of a white tent canopy. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (3) The dog is seen running towards the camera with an orange ball in its mouth, then drops it. The man hits another ball with the yellow bat, and the child runs in the opposite direction while the dog chases the ball. (4) The dog retrieves multiple orange balls, eventually appearing in a close-up shot holding two orange balls simultaneously in its mouth. The background shows lush green trees and a hillside.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic synthesizer BGM starts. A sharp, high-frequency 'thwack' SFX of a plastic bat hitting a ball is heard. A woman's voice provides energetic commentary in Mandarin with a bright, excited tone. (2) The female narrator laughs loudly and makes a playful remark. The BGM maintains a steady, bouncy rhythm. A soft rustling sound of wind and grass is briefly audible in the background. (3) Repeated percussive impact sounds occur every few seconds as the bat hits more balls. The woman's voice rises in pitch and arousal, expressing surprise and admiration. (4) The narrator shouts in excitement as a 'ding' or magical sparkle SFX is heard, coinciding with the dog's achievement. The audio concludes with the narrator's high-arousal laughter and a final upbeat musical flourish.
